blocks.text: Salmon River homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

Salmon River, October 2026. Detached houses: 28 listed at month end and 2 sold in October, a sales ratio of 7% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 3 listed at month end and 1 sold in October, a sales ratio of 33%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 19 sold over 5 months against an average of 24.2 listed, about 6.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 2 sold over 5 months against an average of 3.4 listed, about 8.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 1 sold.

faq.q: Is the Salmon River district in a floodplain?
faq.a: The valley is Fraser River floodplain land; the Township states the Salmon River Pump Station provides flood protection when Fraser River levels rise and was built to mitigate flooding of the surrounding agricultural lands during freshet.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Salmon River address?
faq.a: For the sample address 4452 256 Street, the SD35 School Locator returns North Otter Elementary and D.W. Poppy Secondary, with no middle school shown; other addresses may fall in different catchments. Coghlan Fundamental Elementary at 4452 256 Street is a district choice school on the upland east side.

faq.q: Is the land in the ALR?
faq.a: Farm land in the valley is in the Agricultural Land Reserve in places; confirm a specific parcel on the ALC ALR maps.
Route 562 runs on Glover Road at the Fort Langley edge of the district, between Langley Centre and Walnut Grove / Carvolth Exchange; no route inside the valley roads was confirmed.

faq.q: Can an acreage add a second dwelling?
faq.a: On ALR land the ALC permits one additional residence without an ALC application where its size rules are met (up to 90 m² at 40 ha or less, up to 186 m² over 40 ha), subject to Township bylaws; the Township's small-scale multi-unit rules also allow a suite or accessory unit on lots over 4,050 m² depending on zoning.
